book.mushroom_yorkie.practice.title: Leave it
book.mushroom_yorkie.practice.steps:
Hold this guide. While he chases a squirrel, crouch and Use.
When he turns and comes back, Use a Yorkie Treat on him.
Try again in open ground if he missed you.
book.mushroom_yorkie.repeat.title: Try another squirrel
book.mushroom_yorkie.repeat.steps:
Find a different squirrel. Crouch and Use the guide mid-chase.
Wait for Mushroom to look up at you. Give a treat once he comes close.
book.mushroom_yorkie.trail.title: Heel on the trail
book.mushroom_yorkie.trail.steps:
With him beside you, crouch and Use the guide. Walk past a squirrel on a new trail.
Keep him close. Crouch and Use again when he can go play.
